description: This file defines a ToastService class used for displaying transient notification messages (toasts) in a Blazor application. It manages showing and hiding toasts, with a countdown timer controlling the display duration.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: A service class providing functionality to show and hide toast notification messages within a Blazor application, controlling display timing with a timer.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specified level and initiates the countdown for automatic hiding.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Resets and starts the countdown timer which controls how long the toast remains visible.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Initializes the timer if it hasn't been created yet and sets the elapsed event handler.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the countdown timer elapses, triggers the hiding of the toast.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the timer resource when the service is no longer needed.
